description: Compare two tables by a unique key to find added, removed and changed records. Review changed cell values in a downloadable report. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Requires exactly two tables and a non-empty unique key in each. Row order alone does not create a difference. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: data_compare
title: Compare datasets
